expectations.text: Exactly one SPECS.md and one RUBRIC.md were produced (no v1/v2 or side-by-side alternates)
expectations.evidence: Only SPECS.md and RUBRIC.md exist in outputs/, single files, no duplicates.

expectations.text: SPECS.md contains all required sections: Purpose, Trigger conditions, Inputs, Outputs, Scope & boundaries, Non-goals, Edge cases, Open assumptions
expectations.evidence: All eight sections present verbatim as headers.

expectations.text: SPECS.md content is specific to meeting-notes-to-action-items (not generic boilerplate)
expectations.evidence: Concrete 7-person team, named individuals, a real worked example of messy standup notes, an explicit fork resolution (no Notion/doc connector) logged as a non-goal.

expectations.text: Every RUBRIC.md criterion has a 0-3 scale with concrete, spec-grounded per-level descriptions, and criterion 1 is triggering accuracy
expectations.evidence: 9 criteria, each with a 0/1/2/3 breakdown grounded in specific spec details (e.g. the exact ⚠️ unclear— prefix, the 'Needs an owner' sub-list); criterion 1 is Triggering accuracy covering fire+near-miss cases.

expectations.text: RUBRIC.md has 6-12 criteria plus a scoring summary table with band cutoffs correctly computed against this run's actual max
expectations.evidence: 9 criteria, max 27; bands (24-27 / 18-23 / 12-17 / 0-11) correctly correspond to ~90%/65%/45% of 27.

expectations.text: Transcript shows a self-evaluation pass (Step 5) happening before the documents are presented as final
expectations.evidence: Executor report: self-check caught a Slack-only wording gap and a thinly-grounded criterion before presenting.

expectations.text: Transcript shows at least one round of simulated user feedback followed by a revision (Step 6 loop actually exercised)
expectations.evidence: Simulated feedback merged duplicate-handling into extraction completeness and split out a standalone Tone fit criterion; second self-check ran after the revision.

expectations.text: No SKILL.md-style content (frontmatter, imperative build instructions) appears anywhere in the output
expectations.evidence: grep for frontmatter markers found no matches in transcript.md.
